The solid is a **rectangular prism** since all its faces are rectangles.

Also, notice that:

- The solid is not a triangular (pentagonal or hexagonal) prism since it does not have a triangular (pentagonal or hexagonal) base.

- The solid is not a cube since its faces are not squares.
html:
The solid is a rectangular prism since all its faces are rectangles.

Also, notice that:

  • The solid is not a triangular (pentagonal or hexagonal) prism since it does not have a triangular (pentagonal or hexagonal) base.

  • The solid is not a cube since its faces are not squares.
